selection_policy: Official product documentation and primary project documentation for durable workflow semantics and agent-framework persistence.

sources.title: Temporal Documentation
supports: workflows, activities, signals, timers and retries
limitations: Operational burden and exact SDK/version behavior require a spike
External side effects still require idempotency/reconciliation

sources.title: DBOS Documentation
limitations: Maturity, language fit and long-running Aurora behavior require testing

sources.title: Restate Documentation
limitations: Conceptual/runtime coupling and operational fit require a comparative spike

sources.title: Inngest Documentation — Durable Functions
supports: event waits, scheduling, retries and checkpointed progress
limitations: Cloud/managed orientation may not fit sovereign local-first Core
Self-host and physical/local operation require verification

sources.title: LangGraph Persistence and Durable Execution
supports: checkpoints, threads, interrupts and replay for graph agents
limitations: Framework-specific graph state is not Aurora global state
External effect correctness requires application design

sources.title: Introducing Temporal Workflows in Mastra
supports: separation between agent workflow framework and stronger durable workflow engine
limitations: Does not select either Mastra or Temporal for Aurora
